name: Pasta
intro: The green sauce this month is not basil. Roasted poblano, blended with cream, is the most surprising thing you will make in September.
keep: Dried pasta — spaghetti or something short
Cream, or Greek yogurt, or a little of both
season_options: A spoonful of escabeche on the side

variations.context: The base version. Blend the chiles with the cream and a clove of raw garlic until smooth, then warm it — do not boil it.
Lighter and sharper. Take the pan off the heat before the yogurt goes in or it will split.
Roasted squash folded in at the end. This one eats like a Sunday.

finish: Save a mug of pasta water before draining and use it to loosen the sauce in the pan — poblano cream tightens fast. Cilantro and lime go on after the heat is off, never during.
